text: Computer vision is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One key task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another important task is object detection, which means finding and locating objects in an image. Computer vision has many applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognise roads, other vehicles, and people. It also helps in security cameras and medical images. In short, computer vision is changing the way machines see and understand the world.
